fusions.name: Rafter Pounce
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 dark damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.3 times their remaining damage to the hit. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Lapping Cut
fusions.desc: A swipe of claws in a short arc ahead of you deals 4 slashing damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Padded Flight
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: The Small Hours
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
